privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At DevToolBox, your privacy is our top priority.
privacy.dataText: All tools on DevToolBox process data entirely in your browser. We never send your data to any server. Your input never leaves your device.
privacy.cookiesText: We may use cookies for analytics purposes (e.g. Google Analytics) and advertising (e.g. Google AdSense) to understand how visitors use our site and to display relevant ads. These third-party services may collect anonymous usage data.
privacy.adsText: We display advertisements through Google AdSense to support the free operation of this website. AdSense may use cookies and web beacons to serve ads based on your prior visits.
privacy.thirdPartyText: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.thirdParty1: Google Analytics — for anonymous usage statistics
privacy.changesText: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Check back periodically for updates.
privacy.contactText: Questions about this policy? Open an issue on our GitHub repository.
